name: Double Border
description: Rounded corners with two concentric border lines separated by a clear gap, each with its own width and colour. The lines dim when the surface loses focus. Both widths, the gap, the corner radius and the two colours are this pack's own parameters.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Gap width
parameters.description: Clear space between the two lines (px)

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Roundness of the corners (px, 0 for square)

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two, for a pane that sits against a panel or the screen edge. Every pack in a chain follows the same answer, so the outline stays one shape.

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of both lines, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is a crisper hairline. 0.7 is the soft default.
